claims.summary: The blueprint compiler varies the feedback next-use sentence by lesson while preserving transfer into later artifacts, discussions, synthesis checks, or source-backed tasks.
Lesson-plan ready-to-teach transfer fallback copy rotates the same source-backed next-use idea so the old next-source-based-artifact phrase cannot resurface there.
Existing compiler tests assert feedback-transfer intent instead of requiring the old repeated literal phrase.
The v0.15.135 UX Course FAQ regression compiles a 12-lesson six-question FAQ, runs the texture metric, and proves the old repeated feedback shingle stays out of FAQ text and texture evidence.
